description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component 'TalkOverlayView' along with auxiliary views and classes related to a talking overlay feature in a macOS application. It includes user interaction handling, visual animations, and UI layout components for displaying a talking status indicator with interactive controls.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A custom NSView handling mouse interactions such as clicks and drags, used for interaction within the overlay.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an OrbInteractionNSView instance with callback handlers for user interactions.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the OrbInteractionNSView instance with the latest callback handlers.
